name: sales-trainer
description: Sales Sparring iOS app shell and web prototype.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html logo.jpg manifest.webmanifest dist/ && echo "export { RetellWebClient } from 'retell-client-js-sdk';" > /tmp/retell-wrapper.js && cp /tmp/retell-wrapper.js retell-wrapper.js && npx esbuild retell-wrapper.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/retell.js && rm -f retell-wrapper.js && npx esbuild ./node_modules/@supabase/supabase-js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=supabase --define:process.version='"20.0.0"' --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=dist/supabase.js
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.test: npm run build && npx cap doctor

author: Sales Sparring
